_readme: Model coordinates [x, z] (x = Easting - 832250, z = -(Northing - 815900)). 'areas': HKU campuses - buildings whose centre falls inside are drawn solid and clickable, everything else is see-through decoration; each area gets a name label (at 'label') and an outline on the ground. Buildings listed in places.json always count as HKU; 'include' / 'exclude' force individual building IDs either way. 'hills': terrain inside is drawn as shaded relief with contour lines instead of the aerial photo.
